content.short: Otterspace provides a badge protocol that helps DAOs improve incentive systems, permissions and governance.
content.description: Otterspace is a DAO management and badge credentialing platform crafted for DAO communities. It enables community managers to apply nuanced membership and governance rules, providing clear pathways for joiners and automatic distribution of permissions. It also supports non-financial rewards and recognition for members, helping sustain engagement without financial incentives. Bankless DAO, Radicle DAO, and other groups rely on Otterspace to run an effective non-financial DAO community.
